faqs.question: Is 🤯👀 Gen Z slang?
faqs.answer: 🤯👀 is multigenerational but it sits heaviest in Gen Z and younger millennial chats. The reaction register is fluent across age groups.

faqs.question: What does 🤯👀 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram 🤯👀 punctuates reactions under photo drops and reel comments. The reaction register is the same as on iMessage.

faqs.question: What does 🤯👀 mean if I do not reply?
faqs.answer: If you do not reply to 🤯👀, the combo usually stays a benign reaction. Senders rarely escalate over an unreplied reaction-coded emoji.

faqs.question: Is 🤯👀 an insult?
faqs.answer: No. 🤯👀 is reaction-coded rather than insult-coded. If the message lands as an insult, the surrounding text is doing the work.
